description: 5 words on the same line with large gaps — pdf.js inserts 4 synthetic space items of its own between them. The closest realistically reachable equivalent of 'empty' items to filter (see the note in the .ts about str=="" and the falsy fallback in pdf.js).

expected.note: Items made up solely of whitespace must be dropped before computing fragmentationRatio and other merge statistics, just as real empty items would have to be.
